 <div id="cursor"></div>
 <script>
  let hover_lock = null;
  const is_chrome = navigator.userAgent.includes("Chrome");

  function toggle_theme() {
   const e = root.dataset.theme ?? (matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches ? "dark" : "light");
   root.dataset.theme = "dark" === e ? "light" : "dark", localStorage.setItem("theme", root.dataset.theme)
  }
  toggle.onclick = e => {
   hover_lock = e.currentTarget, document.startViewTransition && is_chrome ? document.startViewTransition(toggle_theme) : toggle_theme()
  };
  const vb = [0, 19, 38, 57],
   l = ["Happy", "Neutral", "Sad", "Dog"];
  let i = 0;
  face.onclick = () => {
   i = (i + 1) % 4, face.querySelector("svg").setAttribute("viewBox", vb[i] + " 0 19 19"), face.querySelector("span").textContent = l[i] + " face"
  };
  const can_hover = window.matchMedia("(hover: hover)").matches;
  let mouse_x = 0,
   mouse_y = 0,
   cursor_x = null,
   cursor_y = null;

  function ani() {
   can_hover && null != cursor_x && (cursor_x += .25 * (mouse_x - cursor_x), cursor_y += .25 * (mouse_y - cursor_y), cursor.style.transform = `translate3d(${cursor_x-75}px, ${cursor_y-75}px, 0)`), requestAnimationFrame(ani)
  }
  document.onpointermove = e => {
   can_hover && (mouse_x = e.clientX, mouse_y = e.clientY, null === cursor_x && (cursor_x = mouse_x, cursor_y = mouse_y), hover_lock && !hover_lock.contains(e.target) && (hover_lock = null), cursor.classList.toggle("is-hover", !(!hover_lock && !e.target.closest(".hover"))))
  }, ani()
 </script>
